title: 30-Day JKD Fundamentals
description: Structured beginner program in 3 phases: Phase 1 (basics), Phase 2 (building), Phase 3 (integration). Master punches, kicks, footwork, counters, and trapping.

days.notes: PHASE 1 - DAY 1: Learn all 22 punches. Focus on proper stance, guard, and straight line principle.
PHASE 1 - DAY 2: Learn all 18 kicks. Chamber position, balance, and hip rotation are key.
PHASE 1 - DAY 3: Master both forward and reverse footwork patterns. Stay light on your feet.
REST DAY: Recovery and mental review. Visualize proper form for punches and kicks.
PHASE 1 - DAY 5: Explosive forward movement. Essential for closing distance.
PHASE 1 - DAY 6: Practice 4 Counts series. Focus on FIRST 8 COMBINATIONS only for now.
PHASE 1 - DAY 7: Counter techniques. Focus on FIRST 6 COUNTERS only. Defense = offense in JKD.
PHASE 1 - DAY 8: Combine punches with footwork. Start slow, build coordination.
PHASE 1 - DAY 9: Kicks with explosive footwork. Perfect your fighting distance.
PHASE 1 - DAY 10: Review 4 Counts (first 8) and Contre Jab Cross (first 6). Phase 1 complete!
REST DAY: Phase 1 complete! You now know all basics. Phase 2 starts tomorrow.
PHASE 2 - DAY 12: Second counter series. Focus on FIRST 6 COUNTERS only. Different attack angles.
PHASE 2 - DAY 13: All 9 trapping entries. Chi Sao fundamentals - feel opponent's energy.
PHASE 2 - DAY 14: Rhythmic footwork. Stay mobile, ready to change direction instantly.
PHASE 2 - DAY 15: Combine counters (first 6) with rhythmic footwork.
PHASE 2 - DAY 16: Trapping with footwork. Stay mobile while controlling.
PHASE 2 - DAY 17: Review all punches, practice Contre Jab Hook (first 6).
REST DAY: Halfway through! Review Phase 1 and Phase 2 mentally.
PHASE 2 - DAY 19: All kicks, all 9 trapping entries. Build your arsenal.
PHASE 2 - DAY 20: Both counter series (first 6 each) with rhythmic footwork. Phase 2 complete!
REST DAY: Phase 2 complete! Phase 3 integrates everything. Final push!
PHASE 3 - DAY 22: Integration begins. All strikes with basic footwork.
PHASE 3 - DAY 23: 4 Counts (first 8) with all Phase 1 footwork.
PHASE 3 - DAY 24: All counters from Phase 1 & 2 (first 6 each) with rhythmic movement.
PHASE 3 - DAY 25: Trapping flow into punches. Sensitivity meets power.
PHASE 3 - DAY 26: All kicks with explosive and rhythmic footwork.
PHASE 3 - DAY 27: Combinations (first 8) with trapping entries and footwork.
REST DAY: Final rest before graduation. Review everything mentally.
PHASE 3 - DAY 29: All strikes and all counters. Your complete striking arsenal.
GRADUATION DAY! Complete integration: combinations, trapping, all footwork. Congratulations on completing JKD Fundamentals! You now have all the basics.

Author: Antoine Giniès
